description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing River Kelpie
When River Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When River Kelpie enters, it and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the River Kelpie trigger, causing you to draw a card
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on River Kelpie
Repeat.
